business_problem: Telkomsel, one of the largest digital telco companies in Asia, faced a "good problem to have": burgeoning sales of its products and services.
solution_summary: Telkomsel used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Speech, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. The company created its now overwhelmingly popular "Veronika" virtual assistant with Microsoft Azure OpenAI.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Speech
solution_components.role: Handles speech recognition and speech synthesis for voice-driven experiences.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Supports model development, experimentation, and deployment for predictive workloads.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
business_outcome: The company created its now overwhelmingly popular "Veronika" virtual assistant with Microsoft Azure OpenAI.
